αἰδώς: αἰδώς — shame, sense of shame, reverence; fem. nom. sg.
αἰθρηγενέος: αἰθρηγενής — born of the clear sky (epithet of Boreas; sense not certain); masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
γαιήοχε: γαιήοχος — earth-holder, earth-carrier (epithet of Poseidon); masc. voc. sg.; the verb behind -οχος (ἔχω ’hold’ or ὀχέω ’bear, carry’) is debated
δαίνυται: δαίνυμαι — feast, dine; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’feasts, is at table’
δεῖμόν: Δεῖμος — Deimos, ’Dread’, a personified attendant of Ares (δεῖμος ’fear’); masc. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive
διέφθορας: διαφθείρω — destroy, ruin; perf. 2 sg. act., intransitive in sense: ’you are ruined, undone’
διὲκ: διέκ — out through, right through; prep. + gen. (διά + ἐκ, epic)
εἰλήλουθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; perf. 3 sg., epic εἰλήλουθεν (= Attic ἐλήλυθε): ’has come’
εὔφρων: εὔφρων — cheerful, glad-hearted (εὖ + φρήν); adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’in good cheer’
ζευγνύμεν: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; pres. inf. act., epic -μεν (= Attic ζευγνύναι)
θάασσε: θαάσσω (θάσσω) — sit; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάασσε): ’was sitting’
θέμι: Θέμις — Themis, goddess of established right; fem. voc. sg. Θέμι, the shortened form of address
θαλερὼ: θαλερός — flourishing, blooming, sturdy; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with μηρώ: ’both flourishing (thighs)’
θυόεν: θυόεις — fragrant, incense-like (θύος ’incense, burnt offering’); neut. nom. sg.
κάρτεΐ: κάρτος — strength, might (epic by-form of κράτος); neut. dat. sg. κάρτεϊ with diaeresis: dat. of respect, ’in strength’
κέλετ: κέλομαι — urge on, bid, command; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (κέλετ’ = κέλεται): ’bids’
κέλετο: κέλομαι — urge on, bid, command; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκέλετο)
καθάπτετο: καθάπτω — fasten on; mid. lay hold of, accost (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’accosted, assailed’ (ἐπέεσσι καθάπτετο ’assailed with words’)
καταπρηνέσσ: καταπρηνής — bent forward, flat, palm down (said of a hand); fem. dat. pl., epic -έσσι (= Attic -έσι), elided
κεχαρησέμεν: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; reduplicated fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic κεχαρήσειν): ’to be glad’
κυδοιμήσων: κυδοιμέω — raise an uproar, throw into turmoil (κυδοιμός ’din of battle’); fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to make uproar’
λείψει: λείπω — leave, abandon; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will leave’
μάρψει: μάρπτω — seize, lay hold of; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will seize’
μαινόμενε: μαίνομαι — rage, be mad; pres. part. mid. masc. voc. sg.: ’raging one!’
μενεαίνομεν: μενεαίνω — rage, be furiously eager; pres. 1 pl. act., + dat. ’against’: ’we rage’
μετάγγελος: μετάγγελος — go-between, messenger (μετά + ἄγγελος); masc./fem. nom. sg., used as a noun, with a dat. ’among (the gods)’
νεμεσήσετ: νεμεσάω — feel righteous anger, take amiss; aor. subj. 2 pl. act., short vowel, elided (νεμεσήσετ’ = -ετε), with μή as a prohibition: ’do not take it amiss’
νεμεσσηθεῖσα: νεμεσσάω (νεμεσάω) — be indignant, feel resentment; aor. part. pass. (dep.) fem. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having become indignant’
νιφὰς: νιφάς — snowflake, flurry of snow; fem. nom. sg.
οἷα: οἷος — of what sort, such as; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα in an indirect exclamation: ’what (deeds)’
οὔατ: οὖς — ear; neut. nom. pl., elided, epic οὔατα (= Attic ὦτα)
πέμπῃσιν: πέμπω — send; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -ῃ), in a general relative clause: ’may send’
πέφατ: φένω — slay; perf. pass. 3 sg., elided (πέφατ’ = πέφαται): ’has been slain’
παυσάμενόν: παύω — stop; mid. cease, leave off (+ gen.); aor. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’having ceased (from)’
περιδείσασα: περιδείδω — fear greatly, fear for (+ dat.); aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’in great fear for’
πεφήσεται: φένω — slay; fut. pass. 3 sg., reduplicated epic future: ’will be slain’
πιθέσθην: πείθομαι — obey (+ dat.); aor. 3 dual mid., unaugmented (= ἐπιθέσθην): ’the two obeyed’
πιφαύσκεται: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare; pres. mid. 3 sg.
πληγέντι: πλήσσω — strike; aor. part. pass. masc. dat. sg. (ἐπλήγην): ’struck, smitten’
προθύρου: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. gen. sg., governed by διέκ: ’out through the forecourt’
προτέρην: πρότερος — earlier, first; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with the object: ’first’, before another
πτῆται: πέτομαι — fly; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg. πτῆται (root aor. stem πτ-), after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’flies, comes flying’
σθένεΐ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg. σθένεϊ with diaeresis (= σθένει): dat. of respect, ’in strength’
ταλάσσῃ: τλάω (aor. ταλάσσαι) — bear, bring oneself to, dare; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., after μή (fear): ’lest he bring himself to’
τετύχθαι: τεύχω — make, bring about; perf. pass. inf.: ’to have been made, to have come to be’
φησὶν: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable), + acc. and inf.: ’says that’
φυτεῦσαι: φυτεύω — plant; devise, bring about; aor. inf. act.: ’to plant (evil), to cause’
χάλαζα: χάλαζα — hail, hailstone; fem. nom. sg.
χείλεσιν: χεῖλος — lip; neut. dat. pl., dat. of means: ’with the lips’
ψευδάγγελος: ψευδάγγελος — false messenger, lying reporter (ψευδής + ἄγγελος); masc. nom. sg., predicate
ψυχρὴ: ψυχρός — cold; adj., fem. nom. sg.
ἀγγεῖλαι: ἀγγέλλω — announce, report; aor. inf. act.: ’to announce’
ἀκούσεαι: ἀκούω — hear; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic ἀκούσῃ): ’you will hear’
ἀλεγίζει: ἀλεγίζω — care for, take account of (+ gen.), usually negated; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’cares’
ἀλογήσει: ἀλογέω — disregard, take no account of; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will disregard’
ἀλογήσεις: ἀλογέω — disregard, take no account of; fut. 2 sg. act.: ’you will disregard’
ἀναπλήσας: ἀναπίμπλημι — fill up, fill full; of evils, suffer to the full; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having filled up’
ἀπηνής: ἀπηνής — harsh, rough, unfeeling; adj., masc. nom. sg., of a heart or temper
ἀπόλωλε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid./pass. perish; perf. 3 sg.: ’has perished and is gone’
ἀργαλεώτερος: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; comparative ἀργαλεώτερος, masc. nom. sg.: ’more grievous’
ἀφήμενος: ἀφῆμαι (ἀπό + ἧμαι) — sit apart, sit aloof; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting aloof’
ἀφρονέοντες: ἀφρονέω — be witless, act foolishly; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -έοντες (= Attic ἀφρονοῦντες)
ἄρηΐ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg. Ἄρηΐ with diaeresis (= Attic Ἄρει): dat. of interest, ’for Ares’
ἐλεύσεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. inf. mid.: ’to come, to be about to come’
ἐννοσίγαιον: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker (epithet of Poseidon); masc. acc. sg. as a noun
ἐπιπείσεαι: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey, heed (+ dat.); fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic -ῃ): ’you will obey’
ἐπιπείσεται: ἐπιπείθομαι — obey, heed (+ dat.); fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will obey’
ἐχολώσατο: χολόομαι — be angry, grow wroth; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’grew angry’
ἔλθητε: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 2 pl., after ἐπήν: ’when you have come’ (plural form, though two are addressed)
ἔλπομ: ἔλπομαι — expect, suppose, hope; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (ἔλπομ’ = ἔλπομαι): ’I expect’
ἔρχεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf. mid. dep., complementing a verb of bidding: ’to go’
ἕρδειν: ἕρδω — do, perform; pres. inf. act. used as an imperative: ’do!’
ἠλὲ: ἠλεός (ἠλός) — distraught, crazed, out of one’s senses; masc. voc. sg. ἠλέ: ’madman!’
ἠπείλει: ἀπειλέω — threaten; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’threatened’
ἰάνθη: ἰαίνω — warm, cheer, gladden; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was warmed, was gladdened’
ἰόντ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἰόντ’ = ἰόντα): ’going’
ἴδησθε: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see, look; aor. subj. mid. 2 pl. (plural form, though two are addressed), in a temporal clause after ἐπήν: ’when you look’
ἵδρυσε: ἱδρύω — make sit, seat, set in place; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’seated’
ὀλυμπίου: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. gen. sg.
ὄθεται: ὄθομαι — heed, care about (+ gen. or inf.), usually negated; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’heeds, takes care’
ὄλωλε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; perf. intr. 3 sg.: ’stands ruined, is lost’
ὑπεξαλέασθαι: ὑπεξαλέομαι — slip away from under, avoid (+ acc.); aor. inf. mid. (aor. stem ἀλεα-): ’to avoid’
ὑπερφίαλος: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant, overbearing; adj., masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θυμός
ῥῦσθαι: ῥύομαι — protect, rescue, shield; pres. inf. mid., contracted epic form (= ῥύεσθαι): ’to protect, to ward off’

__broaden__.αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a second person: ’you yourself’
__broaden__.δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. gen. sg., after ἐδεύετο: ’lacked the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. depending on ἦδος: ’pleasure of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀκουάζεσθον: ’hear of the feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. after ἐπιδευεῖς: ’short of a feast’ · also fem. gen. sg. dependent on ἔργα: ’the business of a feast’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄρχε: ’begin the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης ’the equal feast’)
__broaden__.εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. (neut. pl. subject with a sing. verb): ’go forth’ · also pres. 3 sg. with a fem. sg. subject: ’goes’ · also pres. 3 sg. with a masc. subject, + fut. part. of purpose: ’will go (to)’
__broaden__.ἔχεθ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., elided and aspirated (ἔχεθ’ = ἔχετο): ’was held (as wife by)’ · also pres. imper. 2 pl., elided and aspirated (ἔχεθ’ = ἔχετε): ’hold, put up with’
__broaden__.ἶσόν: Ἶσος — Isus, a son of Priam; masc. acc. sg. · also ἴσος — equal, like; acc. sg. (masc. or neut.), agreeing with the unexpressed subject of φάσθαι, + dat.: ’equal (to him)’
__broaden__.παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + acc.: ’beside’ · also adv., ’aside, to one side’ (παραὶ δέ οἱ ἐτράπετ’ ἔγχος ’and aside for him turned the spear’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (παραὶ Διός ’from beside Zeus’)
__broaden__.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων)
__broaden__.μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’)
